mapper.sql: (o.issuer_unit_id=#{unitId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_branch b JOIN task_assignment a ON a.branch_id=b.id WHERE b.task_id=o.id AND a.to_unit_id=#{unitId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_branch b JOIN task_transfer_request t ON t.branch_id=b.id WHERE b.task_id=o.id AND t.target_unit_id=#{unitId} AND t.status IN ('AWAITING_TARGET','AWAITING_ISSUER')))

SELECT CAST(o.id AS CHAR) AS id,o.task_no AS taskNo,o.title,o.status,o.current_due_at AS dueAt,o.issuer_unit_name_snapshot AS issuerUnitName FROM task_intel_source s JOIN task_order o ON o.id=s.task_id WHERE s.topic_id=#{topicId} AND ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
